> [!CAUTION] > Some comments are outside the diff and can’t be posted inline due to GitHub limitations. > > **⚠️ Outside diff range comments (1)** > >
> Minor · Insert the parent row when an upsert has no document ID. · index.ts:216-218
>
>
>
> > `packages/drizzle/src/upsertRow/index.ts:216-218` > ** Minor** · **Data Integrity & Integration** · **Quick win** > > **Insert the parent row when an upsert has no document ID.** > > For a missing document, `upsert` reaches the `update` branch with no ID. If the data contains only `hasMany` child-table values, the main row holds only timestamps. The `hasMainRowData` guard in the `update` branch (around lines 232-236) then skips the parent insert. The code sets `insertedRow = { id }` with an undefined `id`. The child rows are written with an undefined `parent`, and no document row is created. > > Keep the skip for existing documents. Insert the parent whenever no ID is present: > >
> Suggested fix >
>
>
> > ```diff > - if (hasMainRowData) { > + if (hasMainRowData || !id) { > ``` > >
>
>
> > The fix lives in the shared `upsertRow` helper, so the SQLite and PostgreSQL adapters also receive it. > > > >

Full details: Title check

**Explanation** The title names the affected package (db-d1-sqlite) and the specific change (registering drizzle upsert instead of updateOne). It matches the changeset, which imports upsert from `@payloadcms/drizzle` and registers it in the D1 adapter, with a spec asserting this. The title uses the conventional fix(scope) format and is concise.
Full details: Description check

**Explanation** The description states the bug, the cause (upsert aliased to updateOne without options.upsert), and the fix (importing upsert from `@payloadcms/drizzle` and registering it in the D1 adapter). It also describes the added index.spec.ts test, which matches the raw summary of changes.
Full details: Linked Issues check

**Explanation** Issue `#19766` requires the D1 adapter to register Drizzle's upsert operation instead of updateOne, so payload.db.upsert and payload.kv.set insert missing rows. At head, packages/db-d1-sqlite/src/index.ts imports upsert from `@payloadcms/drizzle` (diff hunk at the import block) and sets `upsert` (previously `upsert: updateOne`) in the adapter object passed to the drizzle adapter setup. This matches the workaround described in the issue and the db-sqlite registration the issue cites. The added packages/db-d1-sqlite/src/index.spec.ts asserts adapter.upsert is the drizzle upsert and not updateOne, which covers the automated-test part of the objective. I did not run the test. The issue's non-code reproduction steps are not assessed.
Full details: Out of Scope Changes check

**Explanation** The whole-PR diff against the merge base 8a157b6 changes two files: packages/db-d1-sqlite/src/index.ts (one import added, one registration line changed) and the new packages/db-d1-sqlite/src/index.spec.ts test. The test directly verifies the change. No unrelated changes appear in the reviewed evidence. The description's note about a 3.x backport is informational and does not add code to this PR.
